chk_primary_result.label: accurate

chk_secondary_result.label: accurate
chk_secondary_result.poster_evidence: Only 4,563 of 27,752 note-derived rows, or 16.44%, had same-visit exact overlap with structured medication history. Semantic and temporal relaxation recovered most apparent disagreements: 38.67% had same-visit category-only overlap, and 35.17% matched within ±30 days after failing same-visit comparison. Cumulatively, 55.17% had same-visit semantic overlap, 90.34% had same-visit or ±30-day overlap...
chk_secondary_result.reason: The poster accurately reports the secondary results regarding same-visit exact overlap (16.44%), same-visit semantic overlap (55.17%), and same-visit or ±30-day overlap (90.34%).

chk_baseline.reason: The poster accurately describes the baselines, including public OMOP/RxNorm synonym matching and generic lexical retrieval.

chk_conclusion.label: accurate
chk_conclusion.poster_evidence: Evidence characterization should therefore precede downstream clinical inference when medication information from clinic notes is compared with structured EHR medication history.
chk_conclusion.reason: The poster's conclusion matches the paper's main conclusion exactly.
